scope: Agent visual/scenario review of actual Files presentation, not a human study or final accessibility qualification
findings: Original icons, native Inter and centered bounded names remain readable; complete names appear in opaque, measured tips.
Details prioritizes names and real sizes at 500x420; Type is available through Sort when its column does not fit.
Active/inactive selection differs; actual owner occlusion hides a stale tip and breadcrumb ancestors remain truthful.
Light/dark USB and actual 150%/4K tip captures remain readable without overlapping essential fixed controls.

carry_forward.observation: Existing shared-menu helper footer uses bounded ellipsis; complete fitting remains planned.
Raw HiDPI captures suggest drawn cursor displacement. Isolate capture timing versus native cursor coordinates; scripted actions alone do not establish pointer usability.
